description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceAuthPayload component within the OpenClawKit project. It defines a test suite with test cases that verify the construction and normalization functionalities of the GatewayDeviceAuthPayload class, focusing on payload vector building and metadata normalization.

classes.name: DeviceAuthPayloadTests
classes.description: A test suite for DeviceAuthPayload functionalities including payload construction and metadata normalization.
